svg.title: The apps that run on Darb
svg.desc: One platform with paths to every app. Darb's own apps: Darb for search and the map, Darb Helpers for friends who add businesses from their towns, and Darb Admin for adding from the street and approving. Apps businesses run on Darb: Darb REST, YellowShifts, Caramel and Raghad Beauty.

g.text: our own API, data, media, maps
Search and map of every business
Friends add businesses in their towns
Add from the street, review, approve
A menu that pours as you scroll
